question: Who is the main architect of Shri Ram Mandir of Ayodhya?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandrakant Bhai Sompura**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Chandrakant Bhai Sompura is the main architect of the Shri Ram Mandir in Ayodhya.
 
• He is renowned for his expertise in temple architecture and has a strong background in traditional Indian temple design.
 
• The design of the Shri Ram Mandir incorporates elements of ancient Indian architecture, reflecting the cultural heritage of India.
 
• Chandrakant Bhai Sompura's work emphasizes the detailed craftsmanship and intricate carvings typical of traditional Hindu temples.
 
• The construction of the Shri Ram Mandir is a significant project in India, symbolizing religious and cultural importance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shri Ram Mandir**

 
 
• The Shri Ram Mandir is being constructed at the site believed to be the birthplace of Lord Ram in Ayodhya.
 
• The temple has been a subject of historical, religious, and political significance in India for several decades.
 
 
 
• **Ayodhya**
 
 
• Ayodhya is an ancient city of India, known for its historical and religious significance.
 
• It is closely associated with the epic Ramayana and is considered the birthplace of Lord Ram.
 
 
 
• **Temple Architecture in India**
 
 
• Indian temple architecture is known for its distinct styles, such as Nagara in the north and Dravidian in the south.
 
• Temples often feature intricate carvings, sculptures, and detailed designs that reflect the cultural and spiritual heritage of the region.
